exercise.name: Decline Machine Chest Press
library_steps: Set the seat so the handles start near your lower chest.
Press the handles down and forward until your arms are straight.
exercise.one_line_summary: Seated upright on the machine, neutral handles at the lower chest. Picture 1: hands beside the lower ribs, elbows bent; picture 2: arms pressed forward and about 30 deg downward (the decline path).

setup.target: Seat high enough that the handles start at the lower chest; back on the pad.

muscles.emg: Lower pectoralis ~100 % MVIC at a -15 deg decline, more than at steep inclines (S1).
muscles.role: Library primary; the whole chest mask is lit.
Keep the trunk still against the back pad.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Upper arms horizontal at the start.
mistakes.why_it_matters: The decline path keeps the elbows low (S1).

sources.citation: Lauver JD, Cayot TE, Scheuermann BW. Influence of bench angle on upper extremity muscular activation during bench press exercise. Eur J Sport Sci. 2016;16(3):309-316.
sources.what_it_gave: Upper pectoralis 122-124 % MVIC at 30 and 45 deg incline (mid concentric); lower pectoralis ~100 % at -15 deg decline, 72 % at 45 deg.

sources.citation: Muyor JM, Rodriguez-Ridao D, Oliva-Lozano JM. Effect of grip width and grip orientation on muscle activity during the seated chest press. J Hum Kinet. 2023;87:23-34.
sources.what_it_gave: Seated machine chest press EMG: clavicular pectoralis ~30 % MVIC with a neutral grip, anterior deltoid ~24 %; grip orientation changes the split between the pec heads.

sources.citation: Solstad TE, Andersen V, Shaw M, et al. A comparison of muscle activation between barbell bench press and dumbbell flyes in resistance-trained males. J Sports Sci Med. 2020;19(4):645-651.
sources.what_it_gave: Bench press activated pectoralis, anterior deltoid and triceps 8-81 % more than the dumbbell fly; in the fly the pec works with a fixed elbow.

clip_check.target: 35 deg (elbows low, by the sides) -> 60 deg, arms forward and down (start 25-45, end 50-70)

clip_check.check: Machine parts meet the hands/feet; levers keep their length
clip_check.target: moving rod lengths equal at start and end (+-1 cm)
